Funnel Plot (multi-backend)

Source: R/funnel_plot.R
funnel_plot.Rd

Publication-ready funnel plot for meta-analysis, displaying study-level effect sizes against their precision (standard error), styled to match the bayesfoRest package. The plot itself only needs study-level yi/sei and a single pooled estimate, so it accepts any fitted model backend that bayesfoRest supports for the pooled line: brmsfit, bayesmeta, MetaStan / stanfit (rstan), CmdStanMCMC (cmdstanr), rjags/runjags, or bayesma. The pooled value is obtained via the same backend-agnostic accessor used by bayes_forest().

Usage

funnel_plot(
  model,
  data,
  measure,
  studyvar = NULL,
  yearvar = NULL,
  yi_col = NULL,
  sei_col = NULL,
  n_ctrl = NULL,
  n_int = NULL,
  event_ctrl = NULL,
  event_int = NULL,
  mean_ctrl = NULL,
  mean_int = NULL,
  sd_ctrl = NULL,
  sd_int = NULL,
  time_ctrl = NULL,
  time_int = NULL,
  subgroup = FALSE,
  subgroupvar = NULL,
  contour_lines = TRUE,
  contour_alpha = 0.15,
  pooled_line = c("posterior", "fixed", "none"),
  color_points = "dodgerblue",
  color_points_outline = "blue",
  color_pooled = "blue",
  color_null = "black",
  color_contour = "grey50",
  point_size = 3,
  xlim = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  null_value = NULL,
  add_null_line = FALSE,
  label_studies = FALSE,
  label_size = 3,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  x_label = NULL,
  title_align = "left",
  font = NULL
)

Arguments

model

A fitted meta-analysis model (any supported backend). Used only to draw the pooled-estimate line (when pooled_line = "posterior").

data

A data frame of study-level data. Must either contain the columns named by yi_col/sei_col, or the arm columns needed to compute yi/sei for measure (as in bayes_forest()).

measure

Character; effect measure. One of "OR", "RR", "HR", "IRR", "MD", "SMD".

studyvar

Unquoted column with study identifiers.

yearvar

Unquoted column with study year (optional, used in labels).

yi_col, sei_col

Optional character names of pre-computed effect and SE columns (e.g. difference-of-medians yi/sei). If supplied, yi/sei are taken directly and no arm columns are needed.

n_ctrl, n_int, event_ctrl, event_int, mean_ctrl, mean_int, sd_ctrl, sd_int, time_ctrl, time_int

Unquoted arm columns, used only when yi_col/sei_col are not supplied.

subgroup

Logical; colour points by subgroup.

subgroupvar

Unquoted subgroup column (when subgroup = TRUE).

contour_lines

Logical; add 90/95/99% significance contour shading.

contour_alpha

Numeric; base alpha for contour shading.

pooled_line

One of "posterior" (posterior median of the pooled effect, backend-agnostic), "fixed" (inverse-variance fixed-effect estimate from the data), or "none".

color_points, color_points_outline, color_pooled, color_null, color_contour

Colours.

point_size, label_size

Sizes.

xlim, x_breaks, x_label

Axis limits / breaks / label.

null_value, add_null_line

Null-effect line.

label_studies

Logical; label points with study (year).

title, subtitle, title_align, font

Display options.

Value

A ggplot object.
